records.claim: The Skilled Migrant Category Points-based pathway requires 6 skilled resident points from one skill category (qualification, New Zealand occupational registration, or income) or a combination of one skill category and eligible skilled work experience in New Zealand. The principal applicant must be 55 or younger and meet the common SMC requirements including skilled employment, English, health and character requirements.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Immigration New Zealand SMC guidance and operational instructions. Evidence is scoped to the Points-based child route and does not promote the parent NZ-skilled umbrella or the other SMC child routes.

records.claim: The Points-based SMC pathway uses employment pay as one possible points category and requires skilled employment or a job offer meeting the applicable SMC wage settings. Current Immigration New Zealand guidance specifies income-point thresholds at 1.5, 2 and 3 times the SMC wage threshold; the current live SMC page displays NZD 35 per hour as the base threshold, subject to the applicable pathway and effective-date rules.
records.methodology: Direct review of current operational instructions and live SMC guidance. This record treats wage eligibility as the route's material financial criterion and does not invent a separate proof-of-funds requirement.

records.claim: Applicants use the Skilled Migrant Category Expression of Interest process and, if invited, apply under the Points-based pathway for which they were invited. Applicants must provide evidence supporting the points claimed and satisfy the residence application requirements in force for the selected pathway.
records.methodology: Direct review of current SMC operational instructions and application guidance; transitional rules are retained where an invitation predates 24 August 2026.

records.claim: New Zealand occupational registration can be the skill category used to claim SMC points when the applicant's occupation is covered by an eligible registration pathway and the registration level maps to the prescribed points value. Registration evidence must be for the occupation and registration authority actually relied upon in the application.
records.methodology: Direct review of current SMC points and occupational-registration guidance; the matrix is route-scoped and does not infer registration eligibility for unrelated residence pathways.

records.claim: Qualifications used for SMC points must satisfy the applicable New Zealand or recognised-equivalent qualification rules. Where an overseas qualification is not exempt from assessment, the applicant must use the applicable qualification or International Qualification Assessment evidence required by Immigration New Zealand before relying on the qualification for points.
records.methodology: Direct review of current SMC qualification and qualification-assessment guidance; exemptions are treated as route-specific evidence conditions rather than generalized recognition.
